tr.td: Included use case — never invoked directly by an actor

td.strong: Awaiting a decision from the 11FTC IT team

ul.li: Employee is not a system actor. They report a concern to a person; IT Staff encodes it. No employee login exists. The dashed association to IT Staff is a real-world interaction outside the system boundary.
Synchronize to Sheet has no human actor. It is triggered by the system when a ticket is written, never invoked by a user.
There is no Void Ticket and no Resolve Ticket. The department has three statuses — Open, Ongoing, Closed. Closing is resolving, and mis-encoded tickets are corrected by Update Ticket, not voided.

div.p: Requirement IDs, SRS sections, and open-item references for every use case above are in 12-traceability-matrix.md.
